description: Create the three-operation CDS OpenAPI contract and architecture gate before parallel implementation.

Act as teammate C. Read `docs/brief.md`, `docs/decisions.md` and organizer-confirmed API standard. Use `cds-contract` and `cds-architecture-defense`. Work in `contracts/` and shared `docs/` only.

Create or update an OpenAPI contract for Cash Withdrawal Request, History Inquiry and Receipt Confirmation. Label any proposed endpoint/field/rule as proposed. Define exact money form, errors, auth scope, branch scoping, pagination, state eligibility, audit effect and retry/idempotency semantics with success/rejection examples.
